A '''hundred-legs''' is described in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]] as "an insect with numerous legs".{{ref|{{twotc}}, hundred-legs}} Not to be confused with a [[Hundred-heads|hundred-heads]].

Nynaeve thinks of the creature when looking out upon the harbour of [[Ebou Dar]]:
<blockquote>Smaller ships still, mastless like the boat she was on, with a high sharp peak at the front and a low flat house at the back, spidered across the water on oars, one pair or two, or sometimes three/One long, narrow boat that must have had twenty to a side looked like a hundred-legs skittering along.{{ref/book|7|13}} </blockquote>
This just the [[Westlands]] name for, and literal English translation of, a [[Wikipedia:centipede|centipede]].
